## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `73639a7c48d12b5348553051869e3c4d2033c003`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectstack-data/evals/objects-fields-relationships.json + skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md (§ Object Extension Model, `main` 33043bd8), packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts (`FieldDisplayPatchSchema`, `refuseFieldPatchOfReplacedField`, `fieldPatchesDescription`), packages/objectql/src/registry.ts (`patchedField`, `applyFieldPatches`), packages/metadata-core/src/extension-field-patch-targets.ts, docs/adr/0146 D10, hotcrm `objectstack.config.ts` / `src/sales/objects/account.object.ts` / `src/sales/picklists/industry.picklist.ts`, .changeset/29969-platform-push-eval.md (semver precedent). Remainder of the diff (`.changeset/28804-data-eval-field-patches.md`): the lane seat's ACCEPT at TIER_DEFAULT.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept set, case 7 `must_contain`** (`hotcrm.custom`, `defineObjectExtension`, `extend: 'crm_account'`, `fieldPatches`, `label: 'Sector'`): each is a whole token (IDENT_CHAR rule of `ui/scripts/check-skill-eval-tokens.mjs`) in `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` on `main` 33043bd8 — 1 / 2 / 1 / 4 / 1 hits, lines 347–372. The dev's by-hand count is reproduced. **Right.** Note: `label: 'Sector'` and `extend: 'crm_account'` are taught at line 364 ONLY, so any rewrite of that example (③ below) must keep both tokens or cases 5 and 7 go untaught.
- **Accept set, `must_not_contain`** `industry: Field.select(`: HotCRM's field is `Field.select({ label: 'Industry', group: 'basic', picklist: 'industry' })` (`account.object.ts` L311–318), so this is the copy-the-vendor's-declaration take-over spelling the skill forbids (SKILL.md L355–357). **Right as far as it reaches** — narrow, see ④ should-fix 1. `overrides:` and `name: 'crm_account'`: the same pair case 5 already refuses; a right answer spells neither (SKILL.md's own `name: 'crm_account'` at L86 is the namespace rule, not an extension). **Right.**
- **Prompt facts**: `hotcrm` namespace `crm` (hotcrm `objectstack.config.ts` L92), object `crm_account` (`account.object.ts` L8), field `industry` labelled "Industry". **Right**; the prompt is the card's reach line verbatim.
- **`expected_output` claims vs the live tree**: display-only whitelist `label` / `description` / `inlineHelpText` / `placeholder` (SKILL.md L357–359, `fieldPatchesDescription` reads `BASE_FIELD_DISPLAY_WHITELIST`); tenant's text wins (`patchedField` `tenantPatched`, ADR-0029 D9.2a); redeclaring in `fields` takes the field over and both-at-once is refused (`refuseFieldPatchOfReplacedField`); unsuffixed field in a `.custom` extension refused (SKILL.md L369–372, ADR-0146 D10); option label keyed by stored `value` only for a field with its own `options`, picklist-bound options never patchable (`patchedField` skips when `picklistBound`; `fieldPatchTargetMisses` reason `picklist-option`); refused at install and by `os validate` (header of `extension-field-patch-targets.ts`). Every sentence holds. **Right.**
- **Self-consistency**: the case's `expected_output` contains all five `must_contain` tokens and none of the three `must_not_contain` tokens (checked by reading the hunk; no in-repo gate covers this bundle — `check-skill-eval-tokens` walks `skills/objectui` only). **Right.**
- **Public surface**: no skill text, schema or runtime change; an eval fixture is inert in a consumer install (`skills/README.md` anatomy) and measured, not ratcheted (`check-skills-token-ratchet` population 1b, ruling record 6513306068 B). `SKILL.md` 6087 tokens unchanged. **Right.**

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/28804-data-eval-field-patches.md`: `'@objectstack/skills': patch`, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`; the PR body carries the same two lines. An eval-only addition to the published bundle is a patch, as the precedent `.changeset/29969-platform-push-eval.md` (platform skill eval, case 12) set. Check Changeset: success. **Clause-②: no** — right: no capability is declared or narrowed; the declaration face owes nothing more.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **`open_questions: []`** — none raised; none found owed.
- **Dev out-of-scope finding (class c) — SKILL.md L364 example patches options of `crm_account.industry`, which is picklist-bound.** CONFIRMED on both trees. `main` 33043bd8 SKILL.md L364 reads `defineObjectExtension({ extend: 'crm_account', fieldPatches: { industry: { label: 'Sector', options: { technology: { label: 'Tech' } } } } })`; hotcrm `main` `account.object.ts` L311–318 declares `industry: Field.select({ ..., picklist: 'industry' })` with no inline `options`, and `src/sales/picklists/industry.picklist.ts` holds `technology`. `fieldPatchTargetMisses` (`extension-field-patch-targets.ts`) returns reason `picklist-option` for any `options` key on a field whose `picklist` is a non-empty string, so the install door and `os validate` refuse a verbatim copy ("Remove `options` from this patch"), and the registry fold's `patchedField` skips it (`!picklistBound`). Reach is WIDER than the dev named: the same example sits in `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts` `fieldPatchesDescription()` (L4997–4998) AND the TSDoc at L5013, in `content/docs/references/data/object.mdx` L581 (generated from the description — fix at source only), and hand-authored `content/docs/data-modeling/object-extensions.mdx` L104–115, which contradicts its own L149–150 ("a field whose options come from a shared picklist has no option labels of its own to patch"). `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md` L3649 shows a prior fix changed `tech` to `technology` but left the picklist binding. The dev's "noted, not filed" does not discharge it: **a follow-up card is owed** (`domain:skills` + spec prose; the filing must keep `label: 'Sector'` and `extend: 'crm_account'` as whole tokens in SKILL.md, ① note). Out of scope here: the dispatch order forbade a SKILL.md edit.
- **Does case 7's accept set inherit the refusal?** No. The accept set neither requires nor refuses `options:`, so an answer that copies L364 verbatim is neither rewarded nor penalised; what is in scope is the reference answer's wording, judged in ④ (should-fix 2). Tightening the accept set to refuse an option patch on `industry` must wait for the L364 rewrite — until then it would red the skill's own taught example and contradict the card's Wanted ("with any option keyed by a stored value").
- **Acceptance note: no runner; `check-skill-eval-tokens` population is `skills/objectui` only.** Answered by this review's own whole-token count (① first bullet). Not a gap this card can close.
- **Acceptance note: overlap with #30890 / #30921 / #30805.** Different files; `compare/main...73639a7c` is ahead 1, behind 0 at review time — no merge owed.
- **Tier H (`skills/**`)**: a governed approver's GitHub approval is owed before merge; whole-PR, outside this record.
- **Check-runs on the head** (13:02Z): every completed non-skipped run is `success` — Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check, Build Core, Test UI, Dogfood Regression Gate, Live E2E UI, all Lint · and Type Check · families, Check Changeset, Check PR Size, PR-body guards, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Auto Label. `Test Core (1/8)` and `(2/8)` were still `in_progress`; the diff holds no runtime code, so they cannot be moved by it, and ACCEPT waits on their conclusion as usual.

### ④ Design judgment

`skills/objectstack-data/evals/objects-fields-relationships.json`, case 7 — against the card's eval prompt and the spec it teaches on `main`:

- Against the card: the prompt is the reach line; `fieldPatches` on a `defineObjectExtension` in `hotcrm.custom` is required; the redeclaration is refused in its taught spelling; option-by-stored-value is stated (prose, correctly unasserted — the prompt asks for no option relabel). Holds.
- Against the code (① fourth bullet): every claim in `expected_output` is what `registry.ts`, `object.zod.ts` and `extension-field-patch-targets.ts` do today. Holds.
- Fixture shape (`id`, `prompt`, `expected_output`, `files: []`, `assertions`) matches cases 1–6; ids 1–7 unique; the hunk is valid JSON (the trailing-comma placement is right). Holds.

Trying to break it:

- **Should-fix 1** — `must_not_contain` `industry: Field.select(` catches only the Field.select take-over. A redeclaration that also changes the type (`industry: Field.text({ label: 'Sector' })`) is a worse take-over and passes the accept set. `industry: Field.` is a strictly broader token at zero cost: its last character is not an IDENT_CHAR so the whole-token rule treats it as a prefix, and the right answer `fieldPatches: { industry: { label: 'Sector' } }` never spells it. Not a FAIL: the taught failure mode (copying the vendor's declaration into `fields`) is the Field.select spelling, and the card's Wanted is met for it.
- **Should-fix 2** — the reference answer for a prompt about `crm_account.industry` spells `options: { technology: { label: 'Tech' } }`, the exact patch HotCRM's `industry` is refused for (reason `picklist-option`), hedged only as "only for a field that declares its own `options`" without saying that `industry` is not one. The answering agent gets no HotCRM source (`files: []`), so a grader reading the reference literally can accept an answer that patches `industry`'s options. Either drop the concrete `technology` / `Tech` spelling from this case's `expected_output` (keep the rule as prose) or state that HotCRM's `industry` takes its options from the `industry` picklist. Not a FAIL: the accept set is not moved by it, and the root is SKILL.md L364 (③, follow-up card).
- Must-fix: none found.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-7ld3bj`
Reviewed-by: `session_01L9qibz5RLVEYDFco93jZ7u`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `894478ff68198fb2dec7505ce7bf6e0d1b21a09f`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectstack-data/evals/objects-fields-relationships.json + skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md (§ Object Extension Model, `main` 33043bd8), ui/scripts/check-skill-eval-tokens.mjs (`wholeTokenPattern`, the `must_not_contain` shape-only rule), packages/metadata-core/src/extension-field-patch-targets.ts, packages/objectql/src/registry.ts (`patchedField`), hotcrm `src/sales/objects/account.object.ts` / `src/sales/picklists/industry.picklist.ts`. Remainder of the diff (`.changeset/28804-data-eval-field-patches.md`, unchanged): the lane seat's ACCEPT at TIER_DEFAULT.

Delta record on the earlier record for head 73639a7c (comment 6685496287): judges only what moved. Everything that record found right and did not move stands.

What moved: fix commit 66ef62e0 (`+2 −2`, case 7 only) and merge commit 894478ff (parents 66ef62e0 and `origin/main` 33043bd8). Net diff `main...894478ff`: ahead 3, behind 0, the same two files, `+10` / `+20`.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept set, `must_not_contain`** `industry: Field.select(` → `industry: Field.`. Under `wholeTokenPattern` the first character `i` is an IDENT_CHAR (left boundary asserted) and the last character `.` is not (exact substring on the right), so the token is a prefix match: it catches `industry: Field.select(`, `industry: Field.text(` and every other `Field.*` take-over of `industry` in `fields`. The right answer `fieldPatches: { industry: { label: 'Sector' } }` does not spell it; no file under `skills/` spells `industry: Field` at all (grep, `main` tree), so no guide sentence an answer might quote trips it; the only spelling in reach is HotCRM's own `account.object.ts` L311, which is the vendor source the prompt forbids touching. `check-skill-eval-tokens` shape-checks `must_not_contain` only (header § "`must_not_contain` is NOT validated against the guides, deliberately") — a non-empty string passes. **Right; should-fix 1 closed.**
- **Accept set, `must_contain`**: untouched (five tokens, 1 / 2 / 1 / 4 / 1 whole-token hits in SKILL.md on 33043bd8). **Unchanged, right.**
- **`expected_output`**: the `options: { technology: { label: 'Tech' } }` spelling is gone; the new sentence reads "HotCRM's `industry` takes its options from the `industry` picklist, and a `picklist`-bound field's options are never patchable, so no `options` entry belongs on this patch." True on hotcrm `main`: `account.object.ts` L311–318 `industry: Field.select({ label: 'Industry', group: 'basic', picklist: 'industry' })`, no inline `options`; `src/sales/picklists/industry.picklist.ts` `definePicklist({ name: 'industry', ... })`. True on objectstack `main`: `fieldPatchTargetMisses` returns reason `picklist-option` for any `options` key on a field whose `picklist` is a non-empty string ("Remove `options` from this patch"), applied at the install door and by `os validate`; `patchedField` skips `options` when `picklistBound`. The conditional rule for a field with its own `options` is kept as prose, so the card's Wanted ("with any option keyed by a stored value") is still stated. **Right; should-fix 2 closed.**
- **Self-consistency at 894478ff**: the case's `expected_output` contains all five `must_contain` tokens and none of the three `must_not_contain` tokens (`industry: Field.` is absent — the reference spells `industry: {`). Fixture parses; ids 1–7. **Right.**
- **The merge**: `compare/66ef62e0...894478ff` brings exactly `.changeset/30512-service-settings-locales-b.md`, `packages/services/service-settings/src/translations/{de,ko,ru}.ts`, `translations/index.ts`, `settings-translation-coverage.test.ts` — service-settings translations, as the dev said. None touches this PR's files, `skills/**` or `packages/spec`; the net diff against `main` is unchanged in file list and line counts. **Right.**

### ② Semver level

Unchanged: `.changeset/28804-data-eval-field-patches.md` `'@objectstack/skills': patch`, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. The fix moves two strings inside an eval fixture; nothing new publishes. Check Changeset on 894478ff: success. **Clause-②: no** — still right.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Both should-fixes of the earlier record are closed on the tree (① bullets 1 and 3). No new dev flag; no `open_questions`; no fix-round os-dev-report on the card or PR at review time — the dev's account reached this review by relay only, and the tree was judged, not the account.
- **Should-fix (PR body, prose remainder, not a `hits` file)**: the PR body still says `must_not_contain` is `industry: Field.select(` (L27 and the maintainer summary) and that the expected output "keeps the `options` form conditional"; both are now false on the tree. Update the body so its account matches 894478ff. Not a FAIL: the body is read, never reviewed, and the tree is right.
- The follow-up card owed for SKILL.md L364 / `fieldPatchesDescription()` / `object-extensions.mdx` (earlier record ③) is unchanged by this head and still owed; the fix did not touch SKILL.md, so `label: 'Sector'` and `extend: 'crm_account'` remain taught at L364.
- Tier H (`skills/**`): a governed approver's GitHub approval is still owed before merge; `mergeable_state: blocked`.
- **Check-runs on 894478ff** (13:17Z): 40 runs — 25 `completed/success`, 13 `completed/skipped`, 2 `in_progress` (`Test Core (1/8)`, `Test Core (2/8)`). Every completed non-skipped run is `success`: Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check, Build Core, Test UI, Dogfood Regression Gate, Live E2E UI, all Lint · and Type Check · families, Check Changeset, Check PR Size, PR-body guards, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Auto Label, Plan Test Core shards, filter. The two pending shards read runtime code this PR does not change (the merge's translation files are `main`'s, already green there); ACCEPT waits on their conclusion as usual.

### ④ Design judgment

`skills/objectstack-data/evals/objects-fields-relationships.json`, case 7 at 894478ff — only the two moved strings re-judged against the card's prompt and the spec on `main`:

- The widened refusal `industry: Field.` makes the card's Wanted ("refuses an `industry` redeclared in `fields`") hold for every `Field.*` spelling of the take-over, not only the vendor's `Field.select`, at no cost to a right answer. Holds.
- The reference answer now says of the prompt's own field that its options come from the `industry` picklist and that no `options` entry belongs on the patch — the exact verdict `extension-field-patch-targets.ts` renders — so a grader reading it literally can no longer accept an option patch on `industry`. The answering agent, with `files: []`, is still fairly graded: the skill teaches the picklist rule (SKILL.md L361–363), and the accept set does not require the agent to know HotCRM's binding. Holds.
- Trying to break it: a take-over spelled without the builder (`industry: { type: 'select', ... }`) still passes the accept set; no builder-free spelling is taught anywhere in the bundle, so no token is owed for it. Not a finding.
- Must-fix: none. Should-fix in the `hits` file: none.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-7ld3bj`
Reviewed-by: `session_01L9qibz5RLVEYDFco93jZ7u`

**VERDICT: PASS**

domain:skills#2 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibz5RLVEYDFco93jZ7u

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：数据技能评测 `objects-fields-relationships.json` 加第 7 题：作者想把 HotCRM 的 `crm_account.industry` 显示成 "Sector"。正确答案是在对象扩展里用 `fieldPatches` 只改 `label`；在 `fields` 里重新声明 `industry`（任何 `Field.*`）算接管字段，判错。题目说明 HotCRM 的 `industry` 选项来自 `industry` 选项列表，不能打补丁。另有 changeset。
- 为什么改：技能里「对象扩展」一段教 `fieldPatches`，但没有评测守着；以后为省 token 删掉这段也不会有任何东西报错。
- 风险与回滚：只加一道评测题和 changeset，不改技能文字、不碰运行时；评测不计入 token 上限。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`skills/objectstack-data/evals/objects-fields-relationships.json` 第 7 题的 `must_contain` / `must_not_contain`。
- 两分钟验证：`node ui/scripts/check-skill-eval-tokens.mjs`（CI 里的 Skill Eval Token Check）应通过，第 7 题的 `must_contain` 词都在技能文字里。
- 需要你做的：改的是 `skills/**`，属于 Tier H，需要 os-zhuang（或 hotlong）批准后才能合并。契约复审 PASS 6685496287，补改后增量复审 PASS 6685772270。

席位意见：契约复审 PASS，两条建议修改都已补上，增量复审无发现。复审另查出技能里 `fieldPatches` 的示例本身在 HotCRM 上会被拒（改的是选项列表绑定字段的选项），已另开 #30944，不在本 PR。可以批准。

## 席位核对
**ACCEPT** · seat `domain:skills#2` · head `894478ff` · 2026-11-06T13:28Z

1. **Shape:** `Fixes #28804`, draft, base `main`, 2 files (`skills/objectstack-data/evals/objects-fields-relationships.json` case 7, `.changeset/28804-data-eval-field-patches.md` `'@objectstack/skills': patch`), fix commit `66ef62e0` plus a merge of `main` `33043bd8` (which brought only service-settings translations; net diff is still the two files).
2. **Ruling:** filing gate ② on #28804, an out-of-scope finding of PR #28795; blocker #28730 closed completed; triage 6684785520 (p3); Claim 6685069739.
3. **Contract review:** PASS `6685496287` at `73639a7c` (no must-fix, two should-fixes). Delta PASS `6685772270` at `894478ff` (same reviewer, both closed): `must_not_contain` widened to `industry: Field.` (catches every `Field.*` takeover; the right answer spells `industry: {`, nothing under `skills/` spells `industry: Field`); `expected_output` drops the `options: { technology: … }` spelling and says HotCRM's `industry` is picklist-bound (hotcrm `account.object.ts` `Field.select({ …, picklist: 'industry' })`; `fieldPatchTargetMisses` reason `picklist-option` on main). `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.
4. **Corrected facts (PR body not patched):** the body cites head `73639a7c`, says `must_not_contain` is `industry: Field.select(` and that the expected output keeps the `options` form conditional; on this head the token is `industry: Field.` and the expected output carries no `options` entry.
5. **Gates / check-runs:** dev reports 40/40 derived families exit 0 at `73639a7c` and again 40/40 at `894478ff` (`--ran`: 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN; list `skills-seat-2/out/28804-gates-ran-894478ff.list`); report 6685331902. On head `894478ff`: 41 check-runs, 28 success, 13 skipped, 0 failed; mergeable_state clean.
6. **Accepted deviations:** none. Residue filed as #30944 (the taught `fieldPatches` example at `SKILL.md` L364, the spec's `fieldPatchesDescription()` and two docs pages patch a picklist-bound field's options); its rewrite must keep `label: 'Sector'` and `extend: 'crm_account'`, which this case's `must_contain` reads.
7. **Landing:** GOVERNED, Tier H (`skills/**`). The seat readies the PR and the relay's governed-review leg requests the approvers; no auto-merge is armed by the seat.
